resources.public_data_use_status: HPRC states that Release II data are publicly available and in the public domain; ethical/data-use best practices still apply.
resources.publication_action: Cite the release/data-use pages, identify exact graph filenames and retrieval date, use population descriptors only where scientifically justified, and do not attempt participant identification.

resources.public_data_use_status: Versioned public graph files, README, and MD5 manifest are available through the International Genome Sample Resource FTP release.
resources.publication_action: Retain and cite the release README and manifest; report the exact 2024-02-23 filenames and checksums.

resources.dataset: Official HGSVC3 plus HPRC-v1 integrated graph
resources.public_data_use_status: The official 2024-02-23 README and MD5 manifest are public; the graph contains HPRC-v1 rather than HPRC-v2 and reports 216 total haplotypes.
resources.publication_action: Treat as a separate integrated-release stress test, not additional independent donors and not an HPRC-R2/HGSVC3 pooled graph.

resources.public_data_use_status: The official timeline targets a stable Summer-2026 release of more than 350 assemblies, but no stable versioned integrated R3 graph and checksum manifest was identified in this audit.
resources.publication_action: Inventory only. Re-audit the official explorer/timeline before submission; do not download mutable pre-release assemblies blindly or describe them as a stable integrated pangenome graph.
